note: Lineup-impact signal framework: what the system should track when starters are replaced by backups (2nd/3rd/4th string) on offense and defense. Verified rows carry values transcribed from the official Week 9 injury report on 2026-11-14; the 'string' designation (starter/2nd/3rd/4th) is NOT official and is left blank/unverified unless a separate official roster/depth-chart source confirms it. Empty cells are intentionally blank: unavailable or unverified.

signals.what_to_capture: Starter and backup QB names, practice status, injury type, and game status; resolve the active QB string.
signals.verified_example: BAL: Lamar Jackson (QB) Thumb / Out; Tyler Huntley (QB) Toe / Out; Joe Fagnano (QB) Full Participation. With the top two QBs Out, the 3rd-string QB is the likely starter.

signals.what_to_capture: Starter and backup CB/S names, practice status, injury type, and game status.
signals.verified_example: JAX: Eric Murray (S) Did Not Participate; Antonio Johnson (S) Limited Participation. BAL: Jaylinn Hawkins (S) Knee / Out; Nate Wiggins (CB) Stinger, Illness / Questionable.

signals.what_to_capture: Starter and backup DT/DE names, practice status, injury type, and game status.
signals.verified_example: BAL: Calais Campbell (DT) Full Participation; John Jenkins (DT) Limited. JAX: DaVon Hamilton (DT) Did Not Participate; Travon Walker (DE) Rib / Questionable.

signals.what_to_capture: Starter and backup WR/RB/TE names, practice status, injury type, and game status.
signals.verified_example: BAL: Mark Andrews (TE) Full; Justice Hill (RB) Full; Adam Randall (RB) Neck / Questionable. JAX: Bhayshul Tuten (RB) Ankle, Foot / Questionable; Jakobi Meyers (WR) Limited.

signals.what_to_capture: An official roster or depth-chart that labels each player's string at each position.
A documented adjustment from availability evidence to a numerical projection, with the source of each input.
